title: Boat Seat Cover 210D – Weatherproof Chair Protector
descriptionHtml:
Keep the boat seat like new

Sun and rain quickly break down a boat's seats. The fabric fades and the seat gets worn after just one season outside.

Durable 210D fabric that protects

The cover is made of heavy-duty 210D fabric that withstands both sun and moisture. It slips easily over the seat and keeps it clean, dry and protected between trips.

Features

  • Heavy-duty 210D fabric that stands up to the weather
  • Protects against sun, rain, dust and bird droppings
  • Easy to pull on and off
  • Fits most boat and yacht seats
  • Extends the life of the seat

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
